title: Tangerine Warfare
description: Throw tangerines that tint people's screens!
body:
![_Pm7 throwing a tangerine at Piffin380, tinting the screen orange upon impact](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pm7-dev/Tangerine/refs/heads/master/promogif_small.gif)

# Tangerine Warfare
This is a fairly simple plugin that adds Tangerines into the game. But instead of being eaten, Tangerines are for throwing. When a player is hit with a tangerine, their screen is tinted orange temporarily, along with a familiar cartoon splat sound playing. A point is given to a player every time they hit someone with a tangerine, and the point leaderboard can be viewed with `/tangerineleaderboard` or `/tleader`. Points can be disabled in config if the server owner so chooses.  

Tangerines have a 33% chance to be dropped by any of the four main passive mobs (Cow, Chicken, Pig, Sheep) upon death. There is no lore reason as to why this happens, I just didn't have any other way planned to make them drop.  

If you get bored of the orange color, you can color tangerines with any [hex color code](https://www.rapidtables.com/web/color/color-picker.html) (ex: #7f5cb8, #36d93e) by renaming them in an anvil to whichever color you want! 
![Recoloring a tangerine using an anvil by naming it "#8e6ed4" to get a nice violet color](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pm7-dev/Tangerine/refs/heads/master/tangerinepromo_anvil.png)

This plugin makes use of a resource pack, which is by default added to players upon joining the game. If this conflicts with your server's resource pack (it should only change the snowball's model data and one default font character), you can disable this automatic pack applying in config, and the resource pack can be found on [(the github page)](https://github.com/Pm7-dev/Tangerine) if you would like to merge them.
